name: OpenBLAS.wasm
description: OpenBLAS optimized BLAS library compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:simd && npm run build:fallback
scripts.build:simd: mkdir -p build dist/browser-simd && cd build && emcc -O3 -msimd128 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_blas_dgemm","_blas_sgemm","_blas_ddot","_blas_sdot","_blas_daxpy","_blas_saxpy","_blas_dnrm2","_blas_snrm2","_blas_dscal","_blas_sscal","_blas_has_simd","_blas_benchmark_sgemm","_blas_get_performance_info","_blas_get_version","_blas_get_num_threads","_blas_set_num_threads","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8","HEAPF32","HEAPF64"]' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=32MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=512MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=4MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto ../src/wasm_module_simd.c -o openblas-simd.js && cp openblas-simd.* ../dist/browser-simd/
scripts.build:fallback: mkdir -p build dist/browser-fallback && cd build && emcc -O3 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_blas_dgemm","_blas_sgemm","_blas_ddot","_blas_sdot","_blas_daxpy","_blas_saxpy","_blas_dnrm2","_blas_snrm2","_blas_dscal","_blas_sscal","_blas_has_simd","_blas_benchmark_sgemm","_blas_get_performance_info","_blas_get_version","_blas_get_num_threads","_blas_set_num_threads","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8","HEAPF32","HEAPF64"]' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=32MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=512MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=4MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto ../src/wasm_module_simd.c -o openblas-fallback.js && cp openblas-fallback.* ../dist/browser-fallback/
